description: Source code implementing a time alignment estimator using Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) methods, including functions for estimating time alignment based on correlation analysis in frequency domain, handling different DFT sizes, and calculating fractional max for peak detection.

classes.name: time_alignment_estimator_dft_impl
classes.description: Class implementing time alignment estimation using DFT, managing DFT processors, and performing correlation-based time offset estimation.

methods.name: time_alignment_estimator_dft_impl::estimate
methods.description: Estimates time alignment based on input symbols, mask, subcarrier spacing, and maximum timing advance, using frequency domain correlation.

methods.name: time_alignment_estimator_dft_impl::estimate_ta_correlation
methods.description: Calculates time offset from correlation data, considering cyclic prefix and sampling rate, including fractional peak detection.

methods.name: time_alignment_estimator_dft_impl::get_idft
methods.description: Selects appropriate inverse DFT processor based on required number of resource elements.
